# Fixture sources and licences

The two downloaded sources are CC BY (attribution below). Every fixture is either derived from one of them or
generated by `make.sh`. Total size stays under 15 MB.

## Downloaded (cached by `make.sh` in `~/.cache/goodfolk-video-fixtures`, SHA-256 pinned)

| Source | Origin | Licence | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bbb-1080p-23s.ogv` | "Big Buck Bunny", the first 23 seconds at 1080p (Theora/Vorbis), (c) copyright Blender Foundation, <https://www.bigbuckbunny.org>. Wikimedia Commons: <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Big_Buck_Bunny_first_23_seconds_1080p.ogv> | CC BY 3.0, stated on the file page (checked 2026-10-25) | `phone-1080p-h264.mp4` and what is derived from it |
| `eclipse-4k-hdr.webm` | "Eclipse (4K HDR)", by gabrielwolfpiano, 3840x1636 VP9 10-bit PQ (SMPTE 2084, BT.2020). Wikimedia Commons: <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Eclipse_(4K_HDR).webm> | CC BY 4.0, stated on the file page (checked 2026-10-25) | `hdr-4k-hevc.mov` |

## Committed fixtures

| File | How |
|---|---|
| `phone-1080p-h264.mp4` | Big Buck Bunny from 3 s, 10 s long, 1920x1080 24 fps H.264 (OpenH264, 4 Mbps) with AAC-LC stereo |
| `portrait-rotated.mp4` | `phone-1080p-h264.mp4` stream-copied with `-display_rotation 90` (a display matrix, so ffprobe reports `rotation` 90 and the displayed size is 1080x1920) and a `location` tag of 6.9271 N, 79.8612 E. The MP4 muxer keeps no Apple-style `com.apple.quicktime.location.ISO6709` key, so only `location` is present |
| `hdr-4k-hevc.mov` | Eclipse from 10 s, 4 s long, 3840x1636, re-encoded as 10-bit HEVC (Main10, `hvc1`) at 6 Mbps with `smpte2084`/`bt2020` tagging. The LGPL ffmpeg has no x265 and its kvazaar is 8-bit only, so `make.sh` encodes with VAAPI (needs a GPU) |
| `silent-720p.webm` | the first 4 s of the phone clip scaled to 1280x720, VP9, no audio track |
| `tiny-e2e.mp4` | generated `testsrc2` + 440 Hz sine, 4 s, 640x360 H.264/AAC. Copied to `web/pms/tests/e2e/fixtures/tour.mp4` |
| `long-61s.mp4` | `tiny-e2e.mp4` looped with `-stream_loop` and stream-copied to 61 s |
| `wrong-codec.mkv` | generated `testsrc2`, 2 s, MPEG-2 video (`mpeg2video`), no audio |
